title: The Garden at Night
themeTags: you are not alone in the dark
reflectionQuestion: Jesus was afraid, but he told God honestly, and God sent an angel to comfort him. I wonder what you would like to tell God about, when something feels scary?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Gethsemane, Luke 22:39-46). Adam's #1 priority. Mood=anxious -- routes a scared/anxious/bedtime-frightened child. WATCH-ITEM (Adam): keep the focus on Jesus PRAYING HONESTLY and RECEIVING COMFORT; the angel comforting him is the emotional center. The coming cross is kept OFFSTAGE ('a very hard day was coming' -- no detail, no violence). The teaching: courage and fear can exist together ('not never being scared, but trusting God even when you are'). Jesus asks friends to stay close; they fall asleep (gentle, 'eyes so heavy', not a rebuke). 'Not my will but yours' kept simple. Soft close ('comfort you'). VOICE_JOHN_BELOVED (tender; John was there in the garden).
